title: Here’s How to Watch UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit Live Online for Free
summary: Live from New York City on Nov. 14, you can watch the entire MMA event online for free.
contentText:

After UFC 333 in United Arab Emirates , the UFC heads to New York for UFC 334. Two prime fighters face off in the championship main event, as French fighter Ciryl Gane (14-2-0) defends his heavyweight title against American Josh Hokit (10-0-0).

Watch UFC 334 with DirectV free trial

And in the co-main event, American Kayla Harrison (19-1-0) takes on Brazilain Amanda Nunes (23-5-0) for Harrison’s women’s bantamweight championship in a title bout.

On Saturday (Nov. 14), UFC 334 takes place at Madison Square Garden in New York City, with a start time of 5 p.m. ET/2 p.m. PT.

How to Watch UFC 334 Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Saturday, Nov. 14

- Main Event Matchups: Ciryl Gane vs. Josh Hokit; Kayla Harrison vs. Amanda Nunes

- Online Streaming: Paramount+ , DirecTV

What Is the Main Event’s Walkout Music for UFC 334?

Although the UFC has yet to announce each fighter’s walkout songs for UFC 334, they usually go out to the octagon to the same songs during their matches. Gane has walked out to “Be With Them” by Tezzus (featuring Protect), while Josh Hokit prefers to walk out to “Real American” (Hulk Hogan’s theme) by Rick Derringer.

As for Harrison, she typically walks out to “Unbreakable” by Jay Kill & The Hustle Standard, and Nunes usually walks out to “American Oxygen” by Rihanna.
